generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Tenderer must be Registered in BWSSB or KPWD/KUWSDB, etc. as per KTPP act and shall furnish valid registration certificate which is in currency.

The Tenderer should upload the Caste Certificate in the Prescribed Format issued by GOK which is Mandatory. The Tenderer Belonging to Schedule Caste or Schedule Tribe shall be Domicile of the State of Karnataka for more than 10 years.If the Contractor is a Firm,then all the partners or members of the firm shall belong to SC or ST as the case may be.
Form of tender is mandatory to upload in e-procurement portal and the rates should not be disclosed.
DI pipes will be supplied from Department stores as per scheduleA
Bid capacity has to be uploaded
ALL THE TERMS AND CONDITIONS ARE AS PER BID DOCUMENT

technicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer should have Satisfactorily completed as prime contractor for at least any construction work to an extend of Rs.16.32 lakh (25 % of the cost of the work of with GST).

Should have executed in any one year the minimum quantities of similar work and completed in all respects including commissioning in a continuous 12 month Laying of 150mm dia and above DI feeder main pipeline for a length of 290 Rmt

Should have executed in any one year the minimum quantities of similar work and completed in all respects including commissioning in a continuous 12 month Laying of of 300mm dia and above DI feeder main pipeline for a length for 800 Rmt

Should have executed in any one year the minimum quantities of similar work and completed in all respects including commissioning in a continuous 12 month Laying of 300mm dia and above MS pipeline for a length of 30 Rmt

The tenderer should have in the last 5 years period achieved in at least ONE financial years a minimum annual financial turnover of Rs.65.28 lakhs. Turnover, Profit & Loss account, Balance sheet statement certified / audited by a Chartered Accountant along with UDIN No. to be submitted

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover
